---
name: Sanitized bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem without device or personal information
---

Before posting, remove all addresses, hostnames, UID/account names, passwords,
certificates, keys, host fingerprints, recovery state, personal paths and raw logs.

**Model / firmware / tool version:**

**Command category:** inspect / verify / patch-copy / experimental bootstrap / cleanup

**Sanitized boolean result or generic error:**

**Is this an already-enabled device or a clean-device bootstrap?**

**Minimal reproduction using synthetic data, when possible:**

Do not attach recovery journals or firmware executables. Use private vulnerability
reporting for security-sensitive details when available.
